issue: CPU Starvation & Tokio Thread Blocking via $O(N^2)$ Quadratic Loop in Binary Pattern Analysis
recommendation: Replace the quadratic nested loop with a linear-time substring search algorithm (e.g., Aho-Corasick or Suffix Tree). Wrap any CPU-heavy pattern analysis in `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` to prevent blocking the async runtime executor threads.

issue: Undefined Behavior & Memory Safety Violations via Unpadded `simd_json::from_str`
recommendation: Ensure all string buffers passed to `simd_json` parsing functions are explicitly allocated with `simd_json::SIMDJSON_PADDING` bytes of trailing padding, or leverage `simd_json::to_padded_value` before parsing.

issue: Control Plane Compilation Failures: Undefined Type Alias and Invalid Immutable Borrow in `datadump.rs`
recommendation: Add `use simd_json::OwnedValue as Value;` type alias to `datadump.rs`. Read the command stdout into a mutable padded string buffer and pass a mutable reference to satisfy the parsing API requirements.

issue: Schema-as-Code Compliance Gap: Ad-hoc Struct Serialization instead of Versioned Protobuf/OSCAL Schemas
recommendation: Refactor ad-hoc serialization structs crossing boundaries into formal, versioned Protocol Buffer definitions (using `prost`). Discovered system capabilities must be exported as valid OSCAL Component Definition models.

issue: Fragile Ad-Hoc Regex-Based XML Parsing bypassing Native Parsers
recommendation: Remove the fragile Regex matches. Parse the incoming XML payloads using the streaming `quick-xml` parser already declared in the workspace dependencies.

issue: Code Duplication: Identical Implementations of `calculate_entropy` Utility
recommendation: Remove the duplicate method definition and centralize entropy calculation into a single, shared utility function.
